subject.title: fix(config): fall back to provider-level contextWindow/maxTokens in model defaults

question: Should the canonical static-config fix include provider-level `contextTokens` with `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, or intentionally land only the two fields reported by the canonical issue?
rationale: Both candidates are correct for the reported fields, but current documentation and the shipped discovered-model path define all three fields as one provider-default family; selecting the permanent compatibility scope requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Unify all three defaults
options.body: Extend this branch or choose the broader candidate so static and discovered model paths honor the complete documented provider-default contract.

options.title: Land the narrow fix
options.body: Merge only `contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, while explicitly retaining the open broader candidate or a canonical follow-up for `contextTokens`.

options.title: Prefer the broader PR
options.body: Pause this branch and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105807 as the canonical landing candidate, closing this PR only after that path is proven viable or merged.

recommendation.title: Unify all three defaults
recommendation.body: Extend this branch or choose the broader candidate so static and discovered model paths honor the complete documented provider-default contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier provider-default implementation established the sibling runtime precedence now being mirrored in static config.
